description: Lists every server key this app has — name, environment (development or, once live, live too), who made it, its access (collections and powers, never a Development/Live-wide "all" granted lightly) and when it was last used. The same list `npx gemmein keys list` and the dashboard's API keys page read. Never the key's own value — that is shown once, at mint (request_server_key) or rotate, never again.
name: keys_list
title: List server keys
